Tuesday’s The Economist/YouGov poll came only a day after the president got less-than-stellar news from the newest Reuters/Ipsos poll released Aug. 24.

For the second week in a row, the poll found Trump’s approval rating sitting at 33%, the lowest approval rating the president has seen in Reuters/Ipsos tracking since his return to the White House in 2025. results.title: Trump approval rating still hovering near record lows, new poll shows

results.content:
The latest Economist/YouGov Poll released on August 11 shows the lowest net approval ratings Trump has received among women (-36), white Americans (-19) and college graduates (-42).

Patrick Casale, Trump supporter and senior adviser to Nevada GOP Chairman Michael McDonald, told Newsweek that he was not surprised to see a decline in approval among these groups.
